scope.question: Whether ReviewBus PR #4396 may carry current-head running-owner evidence through governed integration.
scope.not_a_completion_claim: This evidence counts PR #4396 and its reconcile task complete. It explicitly does NOT count subject PR #4386 or its task row complete.

reevaluation.reason: Human/Ops reopened this task because its blocked state predated the 2026-08-05 reassignment and was never re-examined (root cause tracked in SUP-BLOCKED-TASK-RECONCILIATION-20260804). Every previously recorded blocking condition was re-tested against live state.

prior_blockers.blocker: review_evidence_file_committed called `gh api -f ref=<sha>` without --method GET, so GitHub performed a POST and returned 404 for the exact-head evidence lookup.
prior_blockers.detail: The --method GET fix landed in commit 83b6fd035. However, as of 2026-08-06T11:57:30Z PR #4590 (squash commit 23ae23c21) removed review_evidence_file_committed and test_review_evidence_file_committed_uses_exact_head_get_query from dev entirely.

prior_blockers.blocker: The dev required-status policy contained only Commit trailers, Runtime mirror guard, and Smoke acceptance; it did not require Pantheon canonical review gate, so the bridge status fallback was not policy-recognized and no governed review could be recorded.
prior_blockers.detail: dev branch protection now requires the contexts Commit trailers, Runtime mirror guard, Smoke acceptance, and Pantheon canonical review gate. The required-status review path is live again.

prior_blockers.blocker: Task PR #4550 could not pass Branch CI: commit ba552fc9083cbb189945adb848f58112fa7ef92d had a 76-character subject and the trailer gate re-scans the whole origin/dev..HEAD range.
prior_blockers.detail: The task branch was reset onto the current dev tip and the over-length commit was dropped, because a follow-up commit cannot repair a subject the range re-scan still sees.

pr_4396.outcome: The draft/blocked integration gap this task was opened for no longer exists: #4396 went through protected merge into dev, not around it.

reconcile_task_closeout.closeout_next: Owner finalized approved task after PR #4396 squash-merged into dev as 9cb030dc1b6944334f3717af6c0d5f2fc5f10cd9.
reconcile_task_closeout.note: The reviewer-of-record changed from the Codex pair recorded in the 2026-08-04 gate denial to Antigravity/Claude before closeout, which is what cleared the original approval_reviewer_mismatch.

review_gate_history.detail: An approval recorded by Antigravity did not cover canonical reviewer Codex nor the then-live head. The pending GitHub auto-merge request was revoked as the smallest safety repair (`gh pr merge 4396 --disable-auto`, readback autoMergeRequest: null).
review_gate_history.superseded_by: The task was re-reviewed and closed out under its final owner/reviewer pair on 2026-08-05; no merge ever occurred under the mismatched authority.
